content.text: I want to visit Istanbul solo. Is it safe for women and which areas should I stay in?

Istanbul can be great for solo women! Stay in Sultanahmet or Beyoğlu - well-lit, touristy areas with good foot traffic. Avoid Taksim late at night. The metro is generally safe during day hours, and I recommend women-reviewed accommodations like Cheers Hostel.
What are some safe transportation options for women traveling alone in Bangkok?

BTS Skytrain and MRT subway are excellent - well-monitored with security cameras and women-only cars during rush hour. For taxis, use Grab app for tracking. Avoid tuk-tuks alone at night. River boats are safe during daylight hours.
I'm looking for safe places to eat dinner alone in Rome as a solo female traveler.

Perfect! Try Trastevere or near Spanish Steps - busy areas with good lighting. Sit near windows, avoid basement restaurants. Da Enzo al 29 and Checchino dal 1887 are women-solo-friendly with staff who look out for solo diners. Book early dinner slots (7-8 PM).
